text.p: These are the leading stories in Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- According to the poll carried by the Institute for sociological and political research, 65 percent out of 1,130 polled blamed corruption and theft for social differences in Macedonia. Some 80 percent demanded order and discipline.
- Some 2,600 Albanian citizens were expelled from Tetovo region in Macedonia. Macedonian police recently expelled another 800 Albanians.
- Judiciary employees demand higher salaries and better working conditions, announce strike.

- UNPREDEP confirmed one Finish peacemaker was wounded in a gun fight with Albanian refugees two days ago. UNPREDEP observing post close to Debar, where the incident occured, continues to operate. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
